assets.name: argos-watchman
assets.processing: Original generated PNG copied byte for byte; native alpha preserved
assets.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene.
Asset type: full-body character portrait for CosyWorld's painted Greek drama card game.
Input images: attached portraits are references for painterly detail, natural adult anatomy, woven cloth texture, full-body scale and gentle three-quarter staging. Create the named subject below with the specified face and clothing.
Style/medium: finely detailed painted storybook realism, earthy pigments, soft inner brushwork and an expressive readable adult face.
Composition/framing: one living adult is the sole subject. Tall 1024 by 1536 canvas with genuine transparent background. Show the entire standing figure from crown of head through both complete feet and sandal soles. Give clear margins around the head, hands, hems and under the feet. The figure fills about 86 percent of canvas height. Body at a gentle three-quarter angle, uncovered face and eyes turned toward image-left. Both hands are empty; keep all hands, limbs and clothing inside the canvas.
Lighting/mood: soft neutral daylight with restrained highlights and natural volume, suitable for compositing over both day and night painted scenes.
Output: preserve native clear transparent alpha around the complete figure. Only this single adult and worn clothes occupy the illustration.
Subject: the Argive Watchman, an adult man about fifty. He keeps the beacon account and listens carefully before he speaks. Lean weathered olive face, broad cheekbones, dark brown eyes, cropped dark hair with grey at the temples, and a short grizzled beard. Ordinary night-watch and travel clothes: knee-length unbleached linen tunic, a warm charcoal-grey wool cloak with simple edges, plain leather belt and brown leather sandals. One hand lightly gathers his cloak near the waist; the other opens low toward image-left in a small speaking gesture. He is attentive, tired and dependable. His head is bare, face clear and whole figure balanced.

Subject: Cassandra, a clearly adult Trojan woman about twenty-eight in Aeschylus's recalled homecoming before she enters the house. A long narrow olive face, high dark brows, deep brown eyes, straight nose, and long black hair gathered in two simple braids. A narrow woven hair ribbon keeps her face clear.
